profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Graduated in 2020 with B.S. Computer Science and currently employed at Inncretech.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
I developed .NET Framework (C#) and Spring Boot (Java) versions of a 3D manufacturing machine gateway, and worked with customers and partners to ensure integrations worked as intended.
I developed an Android app to securely encrypt and decrypt QR-code-like images with multithreading, database, and navigation concepts and created releases on the Google Play Store.
I worked on a Spring Boot middleware server to connect a bidding backend with a marketplace frontend.
I worked on a lot management iOS app by contributing bug fixes and coordinating releases with the backend and product teams.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked on setting up Unity environments for experiments using HoloLens.

positions.title: Work Study
positions.description: I developed an inventory Android app and Rest API (using Django) to keep track of the lab's hardware. I also wrote documentation for students.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I worked with Python data tools such as NumPy and seaborn to plot and analyze integrated photonics data.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I worked as a walk-in tutor in DCC's Math & Science Center alongside other tutors in order to provide help with computer science, math, and physics courses.

projects.title: School Agenda Android App
projects.description:
App provides an easy way to record and look up school assignments for students. Additionally, provides notifications to remind users of upcoming assignments. 
Demonstrates use of Android and Google Play Billing API's, understanding of modern app design, and responsiveness to user feedback.
